Use Tier 2: replace uniform negative selection with model-based hard-negative mining, focusing on model_design and training_evaluation. The reference GRU reaches macro validation HR@10=0.5737, while sampled softmax, auxiliary supervision, and convolution reduced performance; retain its architecture and softplus objective. A plausible remaining limitation is that eight uniformly sampled negatives provide too few challenging comparisons to learn the top-ten ranking boundary, although the supplied results do not establish this cause.

For each valid training position, sample 32 uniform negative candidates, reject collisions with that position’s positive target, and score them using the current GRU state and existing scoring head. Select the eight highest-scoring negatives using detached scores, then apply the unchanged positive softplus term and mean negative softplus term to those selected logits, retaining gradients through the selected logits. This changes only how training negatives are selected; keep tied embeddings, learned item bias, score scale, history sampling, optimizer, and all other training settings fixed. Unlike the failed sampled-softmax experiment, this preserves independent binary supervision while concentrating its negative gradients on current ranking mistakes.

Train from scratch with seed 42 on the supplied preprocessing-seed-0 splits, retain all four categories, and keep DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'] with trial-local artifacts and single-GPU execution. Preserve fixed validation with 200 users per category, 99 unique negatives, and evaluation seed 42; select one checkpoint per category by HR@10 with NDCG@10 tie-breaking, and compare authoritative host macro HR@10 against 0.5737. Keep the predictor writer compatible with the unchanged GRU architecture, loading exactly one trained checkpoint per category and using identical validation and inference preprocessing. Bound candidate scoring memory by processing valid positions in chunks, verify finite losses and checkpoint-reload parity, and print the measured Final Validation Score after reloading selected checkpoints; leave hidden-test inference to the host.
